text:
olivia-brown: Morning all, Olivia here — first day on CS. Two blockers: I can't access the demo tenant for walk-throughs, and I don't have the Renewals playbook. Who do I bug?

harry-cs-mgr: welcome Olivia! Ping @sam-ops for demo tenant and provisioning, @julia-salesenable for playbooks & scripts. I'll add you to the shadow rota.

sam-ops: Hi Olivia wave. Which email did you sign up with? I can create access to 'redwood-demo' sandbox and map a demo HubSpot org. Also, do you need API keys for any automation tests?

olivia-brown: olivia.brown@redwood.ai. API keys would be handy later but not needed today. Demo tenant is priority.

sam-ops: Access ticket created: DEMO-9021. Sandbox "redwood-demo" will be provisioned with sample customer data (anonymized) and a HubSpot test org linked. ETA ~4 hours. infra-bot: created ticket DEMO-9021, assigned to sam-ops.

julia-salesenable: I'll share the Renewals playbook and the Churn scripts. We keep canonical playbooks in Drive > Sales & CS > Playbooks > 2026 and mirror essential docs into Notion under CS > Playbooks > Quick Access.

olivia-brown: got a Notion invite but Renewals doc link shows "view-only" and the Drive link is 404.

harry-cs-mgr: fixed Drive perms for you. The 404 was due to a stale link; julia is updating the Notion anchor now.

julia-salesenable: uploaded v2 of Renewals Playbook and two scripts: "renewal-discount-path" and "no-response-follow-up". Also added a short Loom with roleplay. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/drive-id (DMing exact link).

olivia-brown: amazing, thanks. Quick product question: for demo calls, are we allowed to share recordings with Sales for training?

legal-bot: Policy note: customer demo content in the sandbox is anonymized. Sharing internal training clips with Sales is allowed if PII is redacted and clip retention policy is followed. See policy: https://redwood.ai/policies/demo-data.

harry-cs-mgr: short training checklist for you week 1: 1) Confirm HubSpot + demo org access, 2) Set up Aircall softphone + place test call, 3) Get Gong license + watch 4 curated renewal clips, 4) Review Renewals playbook + run 1 mock renewal with coach, 5) Shadow two escalation calls.

olivia-brown: Aircall invite arrived but my softphone shows muted mic. Any tips?

sam-ops: Check browser permissions (Chrome > Settings > Site settings > Microphone). If using desktop app, System Preferences > Sound. If still muted, tell me and I'll push a different softphone number.

julia-salesenable: Pro tip: use the "renewal-objection" canned response set. Drive > CS > Templates > Canned Replies. I'll copy a few high-priority templates into your DM so you can practice.

olivia-brown: received the canned replies. One more: where can I find product one-pagers and pricing sheets for quick reference on calls?

julia-salesenable: Product one-pagers are in Drive > Sales & CS > Collateral > One-Pagers. Pricing is restricted; I'll grant view access after you complete the quick compliance ack (link in Notion).

infra-bot: Provisioning update: DEMO-9021 moved to "ready". HubSpot demo org linked and sample contacts imported.

olivia-brown: can confirm demo org access, looks great. Also confirmed Gong invite 1 accepted. I can't see the renewal clips yet though.

julia-salesenable: added you to Gong playlist "CS Renewals Intro" and tagged the clips with onboarding_renewals. Refresh the Gong app or re-open the invite link.

harry-cs-mgr: final note on recordings: default retention for onboarding clips is 120 days. If you need clips for longer training packages, file a request with me and we can export the clips.

olivia-brown: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll run through the checklist and post any blockers here. Appreciate the quick help! :tada:
